시편 25:1.content: A Psalm of David. Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

시편 25:2.content: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

시편 25:3.content: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

시편 25:4.content: Shew me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.

시편 25:5.content: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

시편 25:6.content: Remember, O Lord, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

시편 25:7.content: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O Lord.

시편 25:8.content: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

시편 25:9.content: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

시편 25:10.content: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

시편 25:11.content: For thy name’s sake, O Lord, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

시편 25:12.content: What man is he that feareth the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

시편 25:13.content: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

시편 25:14.content: The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

시편 25:15.content: Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

시편 25:16.content: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

시편 25:17.content: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

시편 25:18.content: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

시편 25:19.content: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

시편 25:20.content: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

시편 25:21.content: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

시편 25:22.content: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
